rules.cwe_name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
rules.description: Extracting files from a malicious tar archive without validating that the destination file path is within the destination directory can cause files outside the destination directory to be overwritten.

rules.cwe_name: Hidden Functionality
rules.description: Writing network data directly to the file system allows arbitrary file upload and might indicate a backdoor.

rules.cwe_name: Direct Request ('Forced Browsing')
rules.description: A restricted route, URL, script, or file can be requested directly without required authorization.

rules.cwe_name: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')
rules.description: URL redirection based on unvalidated user input may cause redirection to malicious web sites.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer
rules.description: Memory operations access outside the intended buffer boundary.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
rules.description: Using externally controlled strings in a command line may allow a malicious user to change the meaning of the command.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
rules.description: Instantiating a template using a user-controlled object is vulnerable to local file read and potential remote code execution.

rules.cwe_name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
rules.description: Downloading executables and other sensitive files over an insecure connection opens up for potential man-in-the-middle attacks.

rules.cwe_name: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor
rules.description: External links that open in a new tab or window but do not specify link type 'noopener' or 'noreferrer' are a potential security risk.

rules.cwe_name: Password in Configuration File
rules.description: Storing unencrypted passwords in configuration files is unsafe.
